public_rationale: This is a pejorative description of a loosely defined genre of articles. Zitron names no set of articles, no time window, and no test for who counts as a 'captured booster' or for what share is 'mostly'. The phrase about the tool 'burping up training data' is a contested view of how it works, not a trait of the writers that anyone can observe. A search turned up a mix of articles by journalists, developers, company executives and non-coders. No study audits who wrote them, and no ordinary reading turns the label into a measurable test. So the claim cannot fairly be scored true or false.
